limitations: The splitting field and four degree-four closed points are asserted only generically over Q(a,b,c), with the three formal parameters independent; arithmetic specializations may lower the degree. The complex Jacobian Kummer model is not identified with the physical real form over R. Arithmetic tetrahedroid literature is not fully indexed.
scientific_integrity: The published sixteen-node equations and geometric classification are credited to the cited source. The additional squareclass rank and field relations are independently proved by a valuation argument; computations only supplement this proof. No claim of independent audit or priority is made.
title: Generic degree-\(32\) node-splitting field of the Fresnel–Kummer quartic
